name: NeRF Initialization Strategies
definition: Uses weights generated by Points2NeRF from a 3D point cloud as initialization for training a classical image-based NeRF, reducing training time and resources.
summary: NeRF Initialization Strategies use a Points2NeRF hypernetwork to generate structured weights from 3D point clouds, trading high upfront computational cost for drastically reduced NeRF training epochs.
